title: OpenCoworkAI/open-codesign
claim: OpenCoworkAI/open-codesign — Open-source Claude Design alternative. One-click import your Claude Code / Codex API key. Prompt → prototype / slides /
why_good: Turns your Claude Code/Codex key into a prompt-to-prototype/slides design tool — an open 'Claude Design' for non-designers, BYO-model.
value: Team/hosted tier + edu licenses for PMs and founders who want fast agent-made prototypes without a designer or a new subscription.
risk: Same lane as several 'open Claude Design' clones and the model vendors' own design surfaces; needs a sharper wedge.
pick_reason: The project offers a clear product that simplifies AI design for non-technical users, which can be monetized.

zh.claim: OpenCoworkAI/open-codesign —— 开源的「Claude Design」替代:一键导入 Claude Code/Codex 的 API key,提示词 → 原型/幻灯片。
zh.why_good: 把你的 Claude Code/Codex key 变成"提示词→原型/幻灯片"的设计工具——面向非设计师的开源「Claude Design」,自带模型。
zh.value: 团队/托管版 + 教育授权,卖给"想要 agent 快速出原型、又不想请设计师或再开订阅"的 PM 和创始人。
zh.risk: 和好几个「开源 Claude Design」克隆以及模型厂商自家设计入口同赛道;需要更锋利的切口。
zh.hook: 自带 Codex/Claude key,把提示词变成原型和幻灯片。

hook: Bring your own Codex/Claude key and turn prompts into prototypes and slides.
